name: Volume / quantity-tiered discount (PriceAdjustmentTier step-down)
expected: A non-contracted line steps its per-unit price down by quantity band (1-100 / 101-250 / 251+) via the native VolumeDiscount step reading PriceAdjustmentSchedule/PriceAdjustmentTier keyed on QLI.Quantity (Qty=300 -> 251+ band, lower per-unit than 1-100).
actual: The native Volume branch is INERT in active V21 and cannot fire: (1) V21 step 'Volume Discount Entries' (VolumeDiscountEntries, native VolumeDiscount BKM) looks up Price_Adjustment_Tier_Decision_Table with PriceAdjustmentScheduleId = VolumePASIdConstant, and in the Active V21 block that constant value is the empty string '' -> matches no tier rows -> NetUnitPrice passes through unchanged (no-op). (2) Org config: only 1 PriceAdjustmentTier exists org-wide (PAT-0000003633, band 1-10 -> 7%, Product2Id=null) and it belongs to the INACTIVE Volume schedule ZZ_E2E_RCA_20260613 (84XWC000000S6bx2AC, IsActive=false). The only ACTIVE PriceAdjustmentSchedule is 84Xa50000010nWQEAY 'Standard Attribute Based Adjustment' (type=Attribute, not Volume). There is NO active, Tripwire-bound, multi-band (1-100/101-250/251+) quantity Volume schedule anywhere. Tripwire perpetual product FIM-FIM-NRPS-TTBELP (01tWC00000DCxmOYAT) Fortra Price Book PBEs all carry list=0, so it is not even a flat-priceable standalone line. The catalog's named native PriceAdjustmentTier path therefore has no valid data to seed and cannot be exercised. Fortra's REAL volume/quantity-tier discount is delivered by the attribute tier engine (AttributeVolumePricingPrehook v3.0 over Attribute_Tier_Pricing_Storage__c, 1154 rows incl. qty-band keys like 1-25/1-50), validated PASS in B-03 (vol 30 -> band 26-50 -> NetUnitPrice 400, stepping down from list 325).
evidence: V21 active design 9QBWC0000000oWH4AY (Status=Active, VersionNumber=21). Retrieved active V21 block (lines 108729-115123) of Data/pricing-v21-validation/d07/retrieve/expressionSetDefinition/Rev_Mgmt_Default_Pricing_Procedure.expressionSetDefinition-meta.xml: step VolumeDiscountEntries (line 114848) input PriceAdjustmentScheduleId<-VolumePASIdConstant (114701), LowerBound/UpperBound/Quantity<-LineItemQuantity (114708/114715/114750), LookUpId 0lDa50000007BEsEAM Price_Adjustment_Tier_Decision_Table; gating filter VolumeDiscounts (114881) advancedCondition '(1 OR 2) AND 3' = (IsContracted IsNull OR IsContracted=false) AND ItemPricingSource NotEquals 'LastTransaction'; constant VolumePASIdConstant value='' (EMPTY) at line 115117-115120. SOQL: PriceAdjustmentSchedule totalSize=3 (only Standard Attribute Based Adjustment Active, type=Attribute); PriceAdjustmentTier totalSize=1 (band 1-10, inactive ZZ_E2E_RCA Volume schedule, Product2Id=null); Attribute_Tier_Pricing_Storage__c=1154 rows (the working path). Sibling control B-03 PASS quote https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Quote/0Q0WC000003FXpy0AG/view , QLI 0QLWC000003khjO4AQ.
defectStep: V21 step 119 'Volume Discount Entries' (VolumeDiscountEntries) + step 120 gate 'Volume Discounts' (VolumeDiscounts). The gate routes correctly; the action's PriceAdjustmentScheduleId constant (VolumePASIdConstant) is empty -> branch is a no-op. NOT a defect: this is the intended state (native qty-band volume discounting is unused; the attribute tier engine supplies volume/qty tiers).
proposedFix: No procedure or config fix required. Correct the catalog expectation: in FortraUAT V21, 'volume / quantity-tiered discount' is implemented by the ATTRIBUTE tier engine (AttributeVolumePricingPrehook over Attribute_Tier_Pricing_Storage__c, keyed on the Attribute_Volume / Number_of_Units QLIA), NOT by the native PriceAdjustmentSchedule/PriceAdjustmentTier step. Re-point D-07 at the attribute-tier path (use setupTieredSubQuoteTestData.compact.apex, the same fixture that produced the B-03 PASS) to validate the step-down-by-quantity-band behavior. If the business genuinely wants native qty-band volume discounting active, that is a NEW build (populate VolumePASIdConstant with an active Volume PriceAdjustmentSchedule Id + load multi-band PriceAdjustmentTier rows per product) — described, not applied.
notes: Config/parity-class scenario per the method brief (validate via proc+config metadata, no DML fixture). Preflight FAILS because no priceable seed exists for the NAMED native path: VolumePASIdConstant='' (empty) and zero active quantity-band PriceAdjustmentTier rows; the candidate Tripwire perpetual product has list=0 PBEs. Verdict BLOCKED (named native mechanism untestable - data unverified, never FAIL), with rootCause EXPECTATION-ERROR (catalog mischaracterized the mechanism). Building a fresh headless Tripwire/Qty=300 line would only produce a spurious $0/list line through the inert native branch - the exact headless base-seed trap the brief warns to treat as BLOCKED, not a defect. defect_provenance SC-3390 actually points at the ATTRIBUTE tier engine (the two-click stale Attribute_Volume lag, fixed via IsPriceImpacting=true on 26 tiered PADs), confirming the real volume/qty-tier capability is attribute-driven; that path's step-down is already PASS in B-03. No procedure or org-config defect found.
verdict_reason: The native PriceAdjustmentSchedule/PriceAdjustmentTier qty-band path the catalog names is deliberately inert in active V21 (VolumePASIdConstant='', zero active quantity-band tiers, no Tripwire-bound Volume schedule), so it cannot be smoke-tested on any valid seed (BLOCKED); the untestability is an EXPECTATION-ERROR because Fortra delivers volume/quantity-tier discounting through the attribute tier engine (B-03 PASS), not the native step - no procedure or config defect.
